name: Support Copilot
purpose: Draft first-pass replies for tier-1 support using the knowledge base and ticket context.
intended_use: Agents review and edit every reply before send
out_of_scope: Deleting accounts or issuing refunds without human approval

training_data.summary: No fine-tuning; retrieval index built from approved Confluence + Zendesk macro articles.
training_data.gaps: Limited coverage for legacy product SKUs.

evaluation.held_out: 500 labeled tickets (Q4 sample), stratified by product line

potential_harms: Incorrect policy guidance could frustrate customers or breach SLAs
ethical.bias_analysis: Reviewed error rates by language and region; en slightly higher satisfaction than es in pilot.
mitigation: Confidence threshold routes to senior queue

limitations: Does not access real-time billing systems
May hallucinate article IDs under adversarial prompts
failure_modes: Conflicting macros in KB produce hedged or generic answers
Very long threads exceed context; summary quality drops

maintenance.deprecation_plan: v1.4 supported until 2027-01-01 or two major KB migrations, whichever is later

system.system_prompt_summary: Cite KB sources; refuse policy changes; escalate uncertainty.
system.retrieval: Pinecone index support_kb_v3, hybrid search, top-k 8

examples.input: Customer cannot reset password; error 502 on SSO.
examples.output: Suggested steps from KB AUTH-12 + offer escalation if SSO still failing.
